_meta.title: quant_projects branch protection — required status checks (as code)
why_this_file_exists: CI cannot set branch protection itself; it is a GitHub repo setting.
This file is the CODED SPEC of the protection that must be applied, so
it survives audits, agent handoffs, and repo moves. Apply it with the
gh/api command in docs (see apply_command) when the repo plan permits.
apply_blocker: /rulesets) return 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public' on this
repo: private repo + GitHub Free plan (verified 2026-08-28 with a repo-scope admin
token; /user plan.name = 'free'). gh CLI is not installed in this environment.
Apply via docs below once the repo is public, on GitHub Pro/Team, or via an org.
Free-plan workaround that works TODAY: rulesets on private repos are also plan-gated,
so the practical alternative is a required-check reporter job (docs/optional_free_plan_workaround).

_notes.WHEEL_MATRIX_*: Required per matrix leg (8 legs). A matrix job's required check context is the job `name:` with the matrix value substituted — WHEEL_MATRIX_${{ matrix.dist }} — so each leg is individually required. NOTE: while the quant-modeling leg reports NOT_BUILT (task #97 has not landed modeling/pyproject.toml), remove 'WHEEL_MATRIX_quant-modeling' from this list, then re-add it the moment #97 lands; the other 7 legs must always stay.
_notes.POSTGRES_LIVE: Required even while the live tests honestly SKIP (driver not a project-pinned dependency): the job must RUN and report its verdict in the summary. Making it required is what guarantees the postgres:16 service keeps being provisioned and the skip stays loud instead of disappearing.
_notes.scale: 1K_SCALE / 10K_SCALE may be added as required once stable; 100K_SCALE must NOT be required (manual/scheduled, reports NOT_RUN honestly).

_optional_free_plan_workaround.summary: GitHub Free cannot enforce required checks on a private repo. If strict enforcement is needed before the plan changes, run this reporter job on a schedule; it fails (and can open an issue) when any required check is missing on the latest main run.
